name: RGB to HEX
summary: Convert RGB channels to HEX and HSL — instantly in your browser.
description: Enter R, G, and B (0–255), paste rgb() or comma-separated channels, or use the color picker. Copy HEX, short HEX, RGB, and HSL. Runs entirely locally.

faqs.question: What formats can I paste?
faqs.answer: rgb(r, g, b), bare “r, g, b”, or a hex color from the picker.

faqs.question: Does it show short hex?
faqs.answer: Yes, when the color can be expressed as #rgb (for example #abc).

faqs.question: Is my color uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.
